Bugs Found & Fixed in This QA Run

✓Bug 1: brain/api/app.py — settings router imported but not include_router()-mounted. GET /v1/settings returned 404. Fixed by adding settings_router.router to the v1 router list.
✓Bug 2a: brain/db/models.py — AppSetting ORM class missing. brain/services/app_settings.py imported it but it didn't exist → ImportError on settings-related requests. Fixed by adding the AppSetting class to models.py and exporting from db/__init__.py.
✓Bug 2b: brain/api/v1/models.py — BaseModelInfo only returned name, modality, description. Models.svelte referenced best_for, available, use_case, train_vram_gb, serve_ram_gb, hf_repo_id, model_type — all missing. Fixed by extending CatalogEntry with §C display fields and the API response with all new fields plus a live available check (GGUF on disk).
✓Bug 2c: brain/console/src/lib/types.ts — missing BestFor, ProjectSummary, SettingEntry types. Project.summary field absent. Console TS build would fail. Fixed by adding all missing types.
✓Bug 3: brain/console/src/App.svelte — Models and Settings views imported in their files but not imported in App.svelte and not in the route resolver. Navigating to #/models or #/settings silently fell back to the Projects list. Fixed by importing both views and adding routing cases.
✓Bug 4: brain/console/src/components/Layout.svelte — sidebar only had a "Projects" nav link. No "Models" or "Settings" links → §C views were unreachable from the UI even after routing was fixed. Fixed by adding both nav links.
✓Bug 5: brain/console/src/views/Project.svelte — Overview.svelte was created but never imported or added as a tab. Fixed by importing Overview, adding an "Overview" tab button (default active), and rendering <Overview {project} onGoTab={…} />.
✓Bug 6: brain/api/v1/auth.py — GET /v1/auth/members and POST /v1/auth/change-password endpoints referenced by Settings.svelte but not implemented. Fixed by adding both endpoints. GET /v1/auth/members JOINs TeamMember + User to return email+role; change-password verifies current password before updating.
✓Bug 7: brain/console/src/lib/api.ts — missing getSettings, putSetting, deleteSetting, listTeamMembers, invite, changePassword methods. Settings.svelte called them, causing TS errors that would prevent the build. Fixed by adding all methods.
✓Bug 8: brain/api/v1/projects.py — ProjectSummary service created but never called. Overview.svelte reads project.summary which was always null. Fixed by calling compute_summary in GET /{id} and compute_summaries (batch) in GET /.
